note: commands.json - the chat command surface: the names a player may type, what each takes, and the registered operation it runs.

commands.doc: a server transfer to the map the argument names, or one of the reference's refusals (unknown map, no config, already here)
resign from the party: after the pack's delay the member dies; when every present member has resigned the party is defeated and its leader may return to the last outpost
the alias table: the chat half is sent to the player, the table is logged for the operator
broadcast where this agent stands - a position, not AGENT_STOP_MOVING

`/guild create` opens the Guild Registration window, whose form sends the create request (0x8036); ASURA's stand-in for a Guild Registrar NPC (ASURA chat.rs:243-247, guild.rs:254-294). Any other verb is logged with the usage

set total experience; the level is what the pack's curve (experience.json) says, and the bar moves by 0x00EE for a rise of one level or less, or the progress record 0x00E9 is restated (ASURA chat.rs:291-296, player.rs:462-569; preforged's /.exp)
a server line with the character's total experience and level (ASURA chat.rs:297-302; preforged's /xp). ASURA's /xp also sets with an argument; one name is one row here, so setting is /.exp
what this world is running, answered on the console and to an operator client; the reference's own console name for it (cs_server.cpp:92), and it needs no player session
stop the world; the reference's own console name (cs_server.cpp:89), and the process exits with the reference's code 0 (Main.cpp:434-439)

stop the world so a supervisor starts it again; the reference's own console name (cs_server.cpp:68), and the process exits with the reference's code 2, which its main documents for a restarter (Main.cpp:434-439)
